title: 阿兹尔·沙堡茶点
description: 金色鸟首阿兹尔端坐小桌前，用小勺整理迷你沙堡，权杖静放侧架。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Azir is a regal Shuriman bird-headed ascended emperor with a long golden beak, tall narrow crown, bright eyes, and layered gold armor with deep red cloth. Preserve the avian head and elegant upright silhouette, with an opaque full-length robe and covered legs beneath the armor. His long imperial staff stands safely in a weighted holder rather than directing soldiers.
art_direction.scene: At a low courtyard table, he carefully shapes a miniature sandcastle in a shallow wooden tray using an ordinary little spoon. A tiny cup and one date fruit sit nearby, contrasting his grand crown with the modest activity. The staff remains still beside a plain archway, and no army or battle imagery appears.
art_direction.palette: sandy gold, brick red, ivory, muted turquoise
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
